author: __Jeebus__
body: Today I was playing Nebula harmlessly, when I was suddenly attacked by a moderator. He was calling me names, as I kept killing him repeatedly, so I issued a comeback that apparently "triggered" him (it was a fire roast by the way). Shortly after I was perm banned for "ban evading" (what does that even mean bro, really?) Anyways, my lawyer will be hearing about this very soon, unless I am unbanned in the next 24 hours. Thank you and have a good day.

title: Apparently I'm Ban Evading? SnipaCow

replies.author: Fouled
replies.body:
Hello,

Ban evading is when you're bypassing a ban on a different account, which is what you seemed to be doing. Lots of your alts have been previously banned, so in conclusion, your current account has been banned too. 

Also, if a moderator was suddenly attacking you, please send an email to support@avicus.net regarding this and it will be handled.

Your appeal has been denied.

Regards,
Fouled
